{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "Create a premium static portfolio / SaaS landing website for a fitness analytics product called FitPulse Studio. Use Vue for the frontend only, no backend, no database, no login, no API, no real payments. All charts, testimonials, tweets, metrics and client logos can be mock/static sample content. The website should feel like a modern fitness SaaS founder portfolio + product showcase, inspired by the clean social layout of Twitter/X cards and timelines, but with a soft neomorphism design system.

MAIN STYLE
- Neomorphism / soft UI
- Background: warm off-white / very light grey (#F4F7FB), subtle radial gradients
- Cards: soft shadows, inset shadows, rounded 28px corners
- Accent colors: electric blue, mint green, dark navy text
- Modern SaaS look, fitness energy, clean and premium
- Smooth parallax scrolling effects on hero shapes, dashboard cards, floating stats, testimonial cards
- Mobile responsive, desktop polished
- Static website only, everything hardcoded/mock data

WEBSITE GOAL
A landing page for a fitness SaaS platform that helps coaches, boutique gyms and personal trainers show client progress, manage programs visually, and share social proof. It should also feel like the founder’s portfolio page, showing product design, results, case studies, and credibility.

PAGE STRUCTURE
1. Sticky Navigation
Logo: FitPulse Studio
Menu: Product, Features, Results, Case Studies, Pricing, FAQ
CTA button: Book Demo
Use soft pill nav, neomorphic active hover states, subtle shadow. On mobile use a clean hamburger or stacked menu, no real routing needed, smooth anchor scroll is enough.

2. Hero Section
Left side:
Small badge: Built for Modern Fitness Coaches
Headline: Turn Client Progress Into A Beautiful Fitness Growth Dashboard
Subtitle: FitPulse Studio is a static SaaS concept for trainers who want premium progress tracking, program presentation and social-proof style updates without messy spreadsheets.
CTA buttons:
- View Product Demo
- See Case Studies
Trust row:
⭐ 4.9 coach rating
2.4K sample clients tracked
38% average mock retention lift
Right side:
Large neomorphic dashboard mockup with Twitter-inspired activity feed cards:
- “Mia completed Week 4 strength block”
- “Coach Alex posted a new mobility routine”
- “Client progress +12% endurance score”
Include mini line chart, circular progress rings made with CSS, weekly workout bars, mock notification bubbles.
Floating elements with parallax:
+18 workouts logged
92% adherence
New PR achieved
Recovery score 86

3. Social Proof Strip
Create a horizontal logo strip with fake brands only:
UrbanFit Lab, CoreHaus, PulseGym, Lift Society, Motion Club
Add a small note: Static demo logos for presentation.

4. Product Snapshot Section
Title: One Calm Workspace For Coaching, Tracking And Motivation
Use 3 large neomorphic cards:
- Client Progress Feed: Twitter-like updates for milestones, check-ins and coach comments
- Program Builder Preview: clean weekly plan cards, static only
- Performance Insights: mock analytics with soft charts and progress chips
Each card should have small UI mockups, not just text.

5. Features Section
Grid of 6 feature cards:
- Progress timelines
- Workout streak visuals
- Nutrition habit snapshots
- Coach announcement feed
- Transformation portfolio pages
- Export-ready report mockups
Use icons or simple CSS icon shapes. Keep all content static.

6. Parallax Showcase Section
Full width section with layered floating cards moving at different speeds on scroll.
Main headline: Your Coaching Brand, Presented Like A Premium SaaS Product
Elements:
- phone mockup with client feed
- desktop dashboard mockup
- small stat cards
- soft gradient orbs
- quote card
Parallax should be lightweight with Vue + CSS/JS scroll listener only, no canvas, no WebGL, no 3D library.

7. Results / Metrics Section
Use mock numbers in neomorphic stat cards:
87% Sample Client Engagement
4.8x More Visible Progress Updates
12 Week Transformation Timeline
30+ Static Coaching Templates
Add disclaimer text: Example metrics for visual demo only.

8. Case Studies Section
Make it like portfolio work cards:
Title: Selected Fitness SaaS Portfolio Concepts
3 case study cards:
- Boutique Gym Retention Dashboard
- Online Coach Transformation Hub
- Wellness Studio Member Journey
Each card includes challenge, design solution, mock result, and a CTA “View Concept” that can be a static button.
Cards should have Twitter-style mini update feeds inside them.

9. Founder / Designer Portfolio Section
This is also a portfolio-site, so add a personal section:
Name: Jordan Vale, Fitness SaaS Product Designer
Bio: I design soft, conversion-focused dashboards and landing pages for coaches, gyms and health startups.
Include skill pills:
Vue UI, SaaS Landing Pages, Fitness UX, Dashboard Design, Conversion Design, Brand Systems
Add a neomorphic profile placeholder circle, no real image needed.

10. Twitter Inspired Testimonial Wall
Create static testimonial cards in a masonry / feed layout, like tweets but not copying Twitter brand exactly.
Cards include avatar initials, handle-like labels, short quote, likes count, and date.
Example testimonials:
“FitPulse makes our coaching offer look instantly more premium.”
“The soft dashboard concept helped clients actually understand progress.”
“This is the landing page style I wanted for my online fitness brand.”
All fake/static.

11. Pricing Section
Static pricing cards only, no checkout:
Starter Concept - $29 mock
Studio Concept - $79 mock
Elite Concept - $149 mock
Features listed in clean checkmarks.
CTA: Choose Template (non-functional or anchor link)
Add note: Pricing is demo content only.

12. FAQ Section
Accordion style is okay, handled client-side only.
Questions:
- Is this a real SaaS app?
Answer: No, this is a static front-end demo concept.
- Does it need a backend?
No.
- Can the content be customized?
Yes, all copy and mock data are static.
- Does it work on mobile?
Yes, responsive layout required.

13. Final CTA
Headline: Build A Fitness Brand That Looks As Strong As Your Clients Feel
CTA buttons: Start Static Demo, Explore Layout
Add animated soft glow background and floating stat chips.

14. Footer
Logo, short description, links, social-style text links, copyright 2026 FitPulse Studio. Static only.

INTERACTIONS
- Smooth anchor scrolling
- Parallax movement for hero/dashboard/showcase floating cards
- Hover lift on neomorphic cards
- FAQ accordion
- Mobile nav toggle
- Animated counters can be simple CSS/JS from static values
- No external services, no live data

TECH REQUIREMENTS
Use Vue static frontend. Can be a single page Vue app with components like NavBar, HeroSection, FeatureCard, ParallaxShowcase, Testimonials, Pricing, FAQ, Footer. Use CSS only or plain Vue JS for interactions. Do not use backend, database, auth, API calls, Stripe, maps, real Twitter embed, real analytics, or any server features. Use placeholder SVG/CSS shapes for images and mock dashboards. Make it clean, polished, responsive, and ready to run as a static site.",
 "judge": {
  "model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8",
  "model_sha": "94125d2bd83076b21eed33119525e29eaf3894f4",
  "request_model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8:novita",
  "provider": "novita",
  "pinned_on": "2026-10-09",
  "temperature": 0,
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "rubric_id": "rva1:mean(visual,query,asset)"
 }
}

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
